awarded.title: Reallocation depends on the `slot0` price, which can be manipulated
Liquidators can bypass remaining negative margin check and leave the loss to the protocol
One pair can steal another pair's Uniswap liquidity during `reallocate()` call if both pairs operate on the same Uniswap pool and both have the same upper and lower tick during reallocation
Liquidation incorrectly tries to transfer token from Market instead of liquidator if `remainingMargin` is negative
Liquidity manipulation is possible when trading
`updateIRMParams` does not call `applyInterestForToken` before updating `irmParams` which leads to incorrect calculation of interest rate for subsequent trades.
Incorrect price for negative ticks due to lack of rounding down
Chainlink's `latestRoundData` might return stale or incorrect results
Possible DoS When calling `GammaTradeMarket::_removePosition` will cause user position to not be able to get liquidated
Vaults can become immune from liquidation by setting `vault.recipient` to a blacklisted quote token address
Reallocation incorrectly sends the exceed `quoteTokens` to Market contract instead of reallocator
PriceFeed does not return to the correct price for quote pairs
